title: Private min pack: add PrometheusRule resources + per-group toggles; add chart tests
author: Sergio Costa
release_notes:
- Adds PrometheusRule CRs for Private observability minimum pack (SLO burn, pipeline health, resource exhaustion, missing-signals).
- Adds per-rule-group enable/disable toggles for staging vs prod.
- Adds chart tests (helm unittest + template assertions) for rule rendering and gating behavior.
body:
## Summary
Adds PrometheusRule resources to the Private observability min-pack chart wiring and introduces per-rule-group toggles so operators can enable a minimal set in staging while keeping paging-oriented rules for prod. Also adds chart tests to prevent regressions (rule groups missing, invalid apiVersion gating, or toggles being ignored).

This is intended to be the chart-side counterpart to the rules bundle in observability-pack; the actual rule content is kept lightweight here and references the same label/annotation conventions used across the pack.

## Motivation
Private installs frequently run in environments where:
- Prometheus Operator CRDs may not be present at install time.
- Customers want to deploy dashboards first and delay paging rules until after tuning.
- Staging environments should not page but still need "smoke" alerts (missing signals, pipeline health).

We need a safe-by-default, values.yaml-driven mechanism to control what gets installed while keeping a consistent baseline for what Redwood considers "supported".

## What changed
- New templates to render `monitoring.coreos.com/v1` `PrometheusRule` objects when the CRD is available.
- Rule groups split into toggles:
  - `sloBurn` (multi-window burn alerts)
  - `availabilityLatency` (high-urgency 5xx/latency)
  - `resources` (cpu/mem/disk + kubelet/node saturation)
  - `pipelineHealth` (collector/exporter backlog/drops)
  - `missingSignals` (exporter down / no series / rule-eval health)
- Values schema additions under `.Values.privateObservability.prometheusRules.*`:
  - `enabled` (global)
  - `groups.<group>.enabled`
  - `labels` / `annotations` (common)
  - `namespace` override (default: release namespace)
  - `ruleSelectorLabels` (for customers who require explicit selectors)
- Added gating using `.Capabilities.APIVersions.Has "monitoring.coreos.com/v1"` so we don't render PrometheusRule objects into clusters without the Prometheus Operator.
- Added a NOTES snippet clarifying the dependency and how to enable/disable rule groups.
- Added helm unit tests to assert:
  - No PrometheusRule manifests render when CRD is absent.
  - Each enabled group produces a rule group in the rendered resource.
  - Disabling a group removes it (and does not leave an empty group list).
  - Common labels are applied.

## Defaults
- `privateObservability.prometheusRules.enabled: true`
- In `values-staging.yaml` (if used by automation): `sloBurn` + `availabilityLatency` default to disabled; `missingSignals` + `pipelineHealth` enabled.
- In `values-prod.yaml`: all groups enabled by default.

## Testing
- `helm lint`
- `ct lint --charts charts/redwood-private`
- `helm unittest charts/redwood-private` (new)
- Render tests in CI to verify CRD gating + toggles.

## Rollout notes
This is additive and should be safe to merge ahead of the installer wiring. Customers without Prometheus Operator will see no change (no new resources rendered). Customers with Prometheus Operator will get a default PrometheusRule unless they set `privateObservability.prometheusRules.enabled=false`.

## Follow-ups
- Once ENG-2843 is fully wired, we should replace the placeholder group descriptions with the final canonical rule names (keeping group keys stable).
- Align label keys with the signals standard doc once it lands (Allison tracking).

---
### Checklist
- [x] Gated on CRD presence
- [x] Values docs updated
- [x] Chart tests added
- [x] No secrets included

Links: ENG-2843, ENG-2841; internal request INT-1190 for standardized supported-signal checks.

### Small illustrative snippet
Template gating:
`{{- if and .Values.privateObservability.prometheusRules.enabled (.Capabilities.APIVersions.Has "monitoring.coreos.com/v1") -}}`
Group toggle:
`{{- if .Values.privateObservability.prometheusRules.groups.pipelineHealth.enabled -}}`

review_conversation:
Allison Grant: Can we ensure we don't create an empty PrometheusRule if all groups are disabled? Also want to avoid label cardinality explosion from per-route labels in alert labels. 
Sergio Costa: Updated template to only render groups that are enabled; if none are enabled, resource is not rendered. Alert labels are limited to release/namespace/cluster and do not include route/model/tenant. 

Sean Gallagher: Defaults for staging should not page; can we disable burn alerts by default in staging values and keep only missing signals + pipeline health? Also add a NOTE about Prometheus Operator requirement. 
Sergio Costa: Added values-staging.yaml overrides disabling sloBurn + availabilityLatency; added NOTES section explaining CRD dependency and toggle patterns. 

Bruno Silva: Installer expects this chart to be safe in clusters without kube-prometheus-stack. The CRD gating needs to be explicit. 
Sergio Costa: Using `.Capabilities.APIVersions.Has` gate; added unittest verifying that manifests are empty when apiVersion is missing. 

Sahana Iyer: Please add a CI job that runs `helm unittest` and fails PRs if tests are missing. 
Sergio Costa: Added to chart-tests workflow; also included a smoke render with `--api-versions` variants to cover gating.

Approvals: Allison Grant (approved), Sean Gallagher (approved), Bruno Silva (approved), Sahana Iyer (approved).
